name: Electric Ease
summary: Cloud estimating and takeoff aimed at electrical contractors, with prices on its own site.
differentiator: One of the few specialist tools that prints a per-user price on its own site. Its pages describe real-time material pricing updates but do not name the source or say whether it costs extra, and they do not mention NEC or labor units.
pricing: $299 a month per user, or $2,999 a year per user. Enterprise (5 or more users) by quote. 14-day free trial.

scope.library: Customizable assemblies. Counts are not stated.
scope.laborUnits: Labor costs are mentioned, but no labor-unit source is named.

materialPrices.note: Pages say "real-time material pricing updates". The source and any extra cost are not stated.

bestFor: Small to mid-size shops that want a visible price and a cloud takeoff.
skipIf: You need to know the labor-unit source or price feed before you buy.
watchOut: The pricing page FAQ also mentions $199 and $299 monthly figures, which do not match the plan boxes. Confirm the price when you sign up.
